en.quote: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
en.riddle: Thou art old and well stricken in years.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו אַתָּה זָקַנְתָּה בָּאתָ בַיָּמִים וְהָאָרֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָה הַרְבֵּֽה-מְאֹד לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
